data.title: web: attention console page — orientation, cards with inline inputs, running strip, idle-assign

data.text: Spec: docs/04-web.md Main page (orientation line, attention cards with inline answer inputs plus dismiss plus open, running strip, idle-assign cards, collapsed stream chip, summary rail, keyboard a s slash). Wireframes: docs/04 Wireframes. Interaction flows: docs/06-agents-and-skills.md answer flow. Theme CSS vars: docs/01 theme tokens.

Console page renderer landed on matchday/tk-swx (44a3c05 + lib refactor 6c366ca).

- GET / renders docs/04 §Main page top-down: orientation (digest or synthesized counts), amber attention cards with kind chips (approval/question/blocked/idle) and three verbs (answer input → POST /api/answer, dismiss ✕ → POST /api/dismiss, open → /session/:id), running strip (waiting lines carry attention count), idle-assign cards (→ POST /api/assign), collapsed stream chip (toggle = no request, client buffers log events, 500-line ring), summary rail (summaries.jsonl tail newest-first, resolution lines inline).
- Theme: lib TOKEN_HEX → CSS vars + per-session --hue-<id> (new web/src/hue.ts over lib cubeIndexToRgb); zero hex in web/.
- Client script: snapshot authoritative, idempotent deltas, keyboard a/s///Enter/Esc, client-side filter, agent-off fallback hides attention+summary rails.
- /stream transport now fans bus topics out with documented payload shapes; topic→event naming + Last-Event-ID replay remain tk-szb (dependency noted — page coded against the contract shapes, verified in unit tests only).
- bun test 232 pass / tsc clean / live smoke on 127.0.0.1: order, CSP, hue vars, stream first event all verified.
